Journey from classroom to code: I started with a passion for problem-solving, transitioning from academic theory to real-world data challenges. Over time, my focus shifted from abstract concepts to building scalable solutions that drive business outcomes. Today, I’m driven by the intersection of technology and creativity, especially in the gaming industry where data shapes player experiences.  

Current Focus: At LudoQuest Games, I design and optimize data pipelines that power analytics, player insights, and game performance. My work bridges raw data and actionable intelligence, ensuring our teams have the tools to innovate. I’m particularly proud of refining our data warehouse architecture to handle high-volume, low-latency queries—something critical for real-time game metrics.  

Skills Highlight: I’ve built and maintained ETL pipelines using Apache Spark and Airflow, optimized Snowflake schemas for complex queries, and scaled data warehouses to support cross-functional teams. My work with Databricks and Terraform streamlines workflows, while Docker and Kubernetes ensure reliable, reproducible environments. I also mentor peers on data modeling best practices, helping teams align technical decisions with business goals.  

Let’s connect if you’re shaping the future of data—whether in gaming or beyond. I’m always eager to collaborate on solving tough problems and growing together.
